messages.question: can you tell me the course objectives of digital electronics

answer.answer: The course objectives for Digital Electronics (CO 211) are: 1. To know the concepts of different number systems, conversions, and the functionality of logic gates. 2. To analyze and design combinational logic circuits. 3. To analyze and design sequential logic circuits. 4. To understand programmable logic devices.

messages.question: what are the topics of unit-1 in digital electronics

answer.answer: The topics covered in Unit I of the Digital Electronics course include: Digital Systems (Binary Numbers, Number Base Conversions, Octal and Hexadecimal Numbers, complements, signed binary numbers), Codes (BCD, excess-3, Gray), Boolean Algebra & Logic Gates (Basic Definitions, Axiomatic Definition of Boolean Algebra, Basic theorems and Properties of Boolean Algebra, Boolean functions, Canonical and Standard Forms, Digital Logic gates), and Gate-Level Minimization (The Map Method, Four-Variable K-Map, Five-Variable K-Map, Product of sums simplification, Don’t Care Conditions, NAND and NOR implementation).
